14.In this case the prosecution has not examined the victim who is the CW1.
CW1 is the prime witness as he is the complainant and the victim.
PW1 to 4 are police personals and there evidence is only revolving around the manner in which the investigation was conducted.
There evidence cannot be taken into consideration as it is formal in nature.
The entire case of the prosecution relied on the evidence of CW1.
However, he has not been examined by the prosecution.
Hence, in the absence of material witnesses being examined this court holds that the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
